description: Most people tell stories backwards in their marketing. They start with the win. The product. The highlight reel. And then wonder why nobody cares. Here’s the fix 👇 Start with the problem. What wasn’t working. The frustration your audience already feels. Because if they see themselves in the struggle, they’ll keep listening. Next, show the shift. Not some magical breakthrough, just the real moment things changed. Simple. Specific. Human. Finally, land the result. What’s better now? What changed for good? What lesson actually matters? That’s it. Problem. Shift. Result. A complete story in under 20 seconds... and one that actually sells. #marketingstrategy #storytellingmarketing #contentcreator #digitalmarketingtips #onlinebusiness #entrepreneurlife #brandstorytelling #marketingeducation #businessgrowth
transcript: Use this simple three-part storytelling structure to make your marketing actually work. Step one, start with the problem. Not the win, not the product, not the service. Start with what wasn't working. For example, I was working 12-hour days and still chasing leads. Every sale felt random and my follow-ups were a mess. This part matters most. If someone sees themselves in your struggle, they'll keep watching. Step two, show the shift. What changed? Be specific. For example, out of frustration, I built one simple system to track and follow up with every lead. No tech, just a shared doc and a reminder. This part does not need to be complex. Just needs to be real. Step three, end with the result or lesson. What happened next? What changed for good? For example, that one system helped me close more leads without chasing. It made marketing feel manageable again. That is a full story in under 20 seconds, and it works because it's focused, it's personal, and it's useful. So use this format in your next video or post. Problem, shift, result. That's how you turn an ignorable story into a client-generating one.
